versions.content: Error Name : FR_E_LPDU_SLOTSTATUS [_< L P duIdx >] Short Description : FlexRay Protocol communication error Long Description: This production error indicates Flexray protocol communication errors on the network for a particular LPdu. Detec tion Criteria: Fail Each time FlexRay slot status with at least one of the following FlexRay protocol errors active: - v SS!SyntaxError - vSS!ContentError - vSS!Bviolation For details see requirements : SWS_Fr_00605 , SWS_Fr_00606 , Pass Each time FlexRay slot status with none one of the following FlexRay protocol errors active: - v SS!SyntaxError - vSS!ContentError - vSS!Bviolation For details see requirements : SWS_Fr_00 627 , SWS_Fr_00629 , Secondary Parameters: Detection of p rod uction error events is active only during ongoing FlexRay communication. Time Required : The time for detecting an evident FlexRay protocol error in a p articular slot strongly depends on the period of the actual FlexRay slot and thus on the FlexRay protocol configuration parameters. Monitor Frequency continuous
